t: When you are afraid of being left with no one
a: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
p: Rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa anta khayru-l-wārithīn.
m: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
